mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_user ( user_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, phone VARCHAR(64), token VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_user(user_id, name, phone, token) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{token}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), phone = VALUES(phone), token = VALUES(token)
